findings.title: Mercy that interrupts escalation

Those contacts make the focus's عفو and صفح function as two acts that process breach without suppressing truth or continually retransmitting the offense.

findings.containment: The focus still diagnoses covenant breach, hardening, distortion, forgetting, and recurring treachery. The HFT record also preserves the live alternative that the neighboring verses primarily distinguish communities rather than state a direct policy contrast; this finding remains an attributed pericope resonance.

findings.containment: This remains an exploratory regenerative analogy, explicitly bounded by the supplied HFT trace. The primary meanings of hardening, pardon, divine love, and excellence-doing remain recoverable, and the focus is not lexically changed into soil or seed.
